metadata.title: Security Assessment Results - Consent Governance Failure
metadata.remarks: Enterprise-visible assessment results capturing a high-severity consent governance failure for the Medicine Advancement Communications Email Campaign Platform instance.

results.title: Assessment Result - Consent Governance
results.description: Assessment result documenting use of audience data without verifiable consent from an authoritative source.

findings.title: Consent Not Obtained from Authoritative Source
findings.description: One or more email campaigns were executed without verifiable, certified consent eligibility from the designated authoritative consent system under an approved data exchange agreement.

associated-risk.title: Unlawful Electronic Communication
associated-risk.description: Execution of campaigns without verified consent may violate statutory electronic communications requirements, exposing the institution to enforcement, fines, and reputational harm.

remediations.title: Consent Governance Remediation Plan
remediations.description: Mandatory remediation to restore authoritative consent verification prior to any campaign execution.

tasks.title: Verify Authoritative Consent Source
tasks.description: Identify and document the authoritative consent system for all audience data used in campaigns.

tasks.title: Enforce Certified Consent Gate
tasks.description: Prevent campaign approval or release unless certified consent state is present.

tasks.title: Validate Data Exchange Agreement
tasks.description: Confirm or establish a formal data exchange agreement defining consent certification and audit requirements.
